title: Scariest Drivers in South Florida, by Area
igCaption:
Brickell drivers, this one's for you 😤🚗

Which area has the scariest drivers? Wrong answers only 👇 and tag the worst driver you know.

(satire — but seriously, use your blinker)

#miami #brickell #southflorida #miamidrivers #palmetto #dadeland #aventura #lasolas #fortlauderdale #floridadrivers #miamilife #miamitraffic #roadrage

scenes.text: If you drive in Brickell, I'm sorry. Number one on this list is you. And I have proof.
Number five, Aventura Mall on a Sunday. Forty minutes looking for parking, and a white Range Rover still stole my spot. Then waved at me.
Number four, Dadeland. Kendall Drive and U.S. One. Nobody signals there. My uncle says a blinker just tells the other guy your plan.
scenes.caption: Number four, Dadeland. Kendall Drive and US-1. Nobody signals there. My uncle says a blinker just tells the other guy your plan.

scenes.text: Number three, Las Olas. The bridge starts going up, and somebody always tries to jump it. Okay, but number two is actually illegal.

location.name: Las Olas Boulevard bridge, Fort Lauderdale

scenes.text: Number two, the Palmetto at five thirty. I watched a guy cut across five lanes for the Coral Way exit. From the far left. He didn't even look.
scenes.caption: Number two, the Palmetto at 5:30. I watched a guy cut across five lanes for the Coral Way exit. From the far left. He didn't even look.

scenes.text: And number one... Brickell. Scooters on the sidewalk, Lambos double parked, and an Uber that stopped in the middle lane so the driver could finish his empanada.
